# WorkStation

> WorkStation is an interactive hardware showcase built with Vue 3 and TypeScript by Dawid Olko. It presents a gaming and productivity setup with photos and specifications of every component.

## Pages

- [Home](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/): overview of the setup
- [Setup](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/setup/): photos of the whole station
- [Components](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/components/): every component by category
- [Specs](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/specs/): full technical specifications

## Categories

- [PC](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/pc/): the desktop computer
- [Laptop](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/laptop/): the MacBook Pro
- [Monitors](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/monitors/): the three displays
- [Peripherals](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/peripherals/): keyboard, mice, headset and printer
- [Audio](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/audio/): speakers, microphone and cameras
- [Workspace](https://workstation.dawidolko.pl/workspace/): desk and chair

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
